{{Top|leg}}
The '''Festival of Four Honorings''' was an event held at the [[Marblewood Estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. It would last over seven days with a day each to devoted to stone, air, water, and fire and a prep day in between each. It was meant to mirror and be grander than the [[Carnival Week]] celebration on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
